scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Research Or Innovation
other_conditions: Open to all Indian institutions, organizations, and individuals irrespective of religion, race, sex, caste or creed.
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized agency or person; self‑nominations are not accepted.
A previous awardee is ineligible for the next three award cycles.
Eligible nominees must have at least five years of outstanding contributions in addiction prevention, research, treatment, or related fields.
Preference is given to those currently active in the field.
Nominee should have developed treatment or prevention modules, cost‑effective models, research publications, manuals or booklets, and evidence‑based research on relevant population groups.
benefits_summary: Award includes a citation, memento and a cash prize of ₹5,00,000.
